name: PowOS app's root/shell helpers
purpose: what the PowOS app (com.powos.app) starts through su outside PowOS: WebWindowsHost (app_process as shell: native windows inside the web UI, docs/WEB_WINDOWS.md) with its uinput devices, and the power key's `getevent -ql` (assist/PowerKey.kt). They end with the app (their su pipe closes)
